import pandas as pd
p='airlines/B6.csv'
df=pd.read_csv(p)
print(df.shape)
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.head())
print(df['cancelled'].value_counts(dropna=False))
sub=df[df['date'].astype(str).eq('2025-02-14')]
print('date matches',len(sub), 'cancel counts',sub['cancelled'].value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict())
print(sub[['flight_id','date','cancelled','actual_dep']].to_string(index=False))
